conviction_note: A small long lean: Q3 2026 is the first full Helios lease quarter and the quarter BTC rose ~43% and ETH ~71% after a Q2 the market sold -12% on treasury losses, into a stock down 33% in 20 days on CoreWeave credit fear with short interest rising four settlements in a row. But the crypto path is public, the EPS bar is disputed (-0.12 / +0.05 / -0.44), and this name has fallen after 5 of its last 7 prints, so p_up is 55 and not higher. The scaled number is (2*0.55-1)*11 = +1.1, against a findings sum of +2.2. The gap is the reaction history (beats sold) and the CoreWeave overhang that Galaxy cannot resolve on its own call.
bar: Disputed. Q3 2026 EPS consensus -$0.12 on 6 estimates per an aggregator (summarised via unusualwhales/therighttrader; https://unusualwhales.com/stock/GLXY/earnings), +$0.05 on Benzinga (priced 2026-08-05, stale; https://www.benzinga.com/quote/GLXY/earnings-forecasts), and Maxim -$0.44 (2026-08-11; https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/maxim-group-comments-on-galaxy-digital-q3-earnings-2026-08-11/). The bar does not resolve to two agreeing sources, so every finding is capped small. The company's own guide covers one line only: Helios Phase I at about $80M of quarterly leasing revenue at a >90% project EBITDA margin from Q3 2026 (Q2 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001859392/000185939226000084/glxy-20260630xpressrelease.htm). print_vs_bar_pct is in percent of the |EPS bar| of -$0.12: I expect a GAAP/adjusted EPS at or above zero on crypto marks, which is a beat of about 100% of the bar's magnitude. It is low-confidence, because EPS near zero makes a percent unstable.
positioning_check: Short interest 32.63M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up from 27.16M on 08-14 and rising four settlements running. Days to cover 6.73. About 8.3% of the 390.9M shares outstanding, and higher as a share of the Class A float, which the page does not give (https://equibles.com/stocks/glxy/shortinterest, read 2026-10-26). The 25d skew is -1.02 vol points (balanced, slight call bid), put/call OI is 1.09, ATM IV is 138%, and the event-implied move is 11.34% (sealed baseline). Spot $15.47 is 33.4% down over 20 days, 61.9% off the 52w high and 5.4% above the 52w low. A growing short with nearly 7 days to cover, into a stock at its lows, is a squeeze mechanism on any reassurance.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 crypto marks were strongly positive. BTC rose about 43% (from ~$58.5k to ~$84k) and ETH 71% in the quarter. Q2 2026 Treasury & Corporate posted an adjusted gross loss of $(42)M on $1.16B of net digital assets and investments (spot BTC, BTC derivatives, SOL), and Q2 net loss was $(85)M. So Q3 should swing to a material mark-to-market gain and plausibly positive net income, against an EPS bar of -$0.12 (6 est.).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-05): -13.89%. The Block attributes it to the $85M treasury-driven loss despite Helios gains (https://theblock.co/post/410851/galaxy-shares-sink-11-after-85-million-q2-loss-despite-ai-data-center-gains). Q3 2025 (2025-10-21), a record profit quarter on strong crypto: +8.1%. Q1 2026 ($216M loss): +5.23%. So the headline P&L sign has mattered both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: The crypto path is public, so this is partly priced. The EPS bar is stale (Benzinga's priced 2026-08-05) and disputed across three sources, so it may not carry the full Q3 mark. The stock fell 33% in October, which is the opposite of what a market pricing a strong reported quarter would do; that fall is a CoreWeave-credit story, not a Q3 P&L story. Sized small because the bar is unsourced and the gains are below operating income.
findings.independence: Cryptobriefing 2026-10-02 confirms BTC +42.9% in Q3 2026, ~$58.5k to $83-86k (https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-jumps-q3-2026-outperforms-gold-stocks/). The Treasury exposure figures come from the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001859392/000185939226000084/glxy-20260630xpressrelease.htm).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first full quarter of Helios Phase I. The company guided about $80M of quarterly leasing revenue at a >90% project-level adjusted EBITDA margin from Q3, with all 133 MW of critical IT in service by 2026-06-30, against Q2's partial $20M adjusted gross profit and $11M EBITDA. This lands inside the company's own guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 was the first Data Centers revenue quarter, and the stock fell 13.89% because treasury losses dominated. No prior quarter shows the stock paying for this line on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, because the company told the market to expect it. Only a shortfall (a CoreWeave payment delay or credit) or an upside (power pass-through, early Phase II) would move the stock, and nothing points to either.
findings.independence: Q2 call summaries repeat the ~$80M per quarter from Q3 (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9007532/galaxy-digital-inc-glxy-q2-2026-earnings-call-highlights-data-center-expansion-drives-growth-amid-crypto-volatility). That is the same company statement, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: CoreWeave, Helios's sole tenant (526 MW of critical IT; the release cites over $1.2B of average annual revenue), went through a credit scare in mid-October 2026: its 2032 notes yielded up to 15%, CDS rose above 1,000bp, and the stock fell about 25% in the week of Oct 14. GLXY fell about 30% in two weeks alongside it. The Q3 call on Oct 27 is management's first public chance to set out lease credit protections, CoreWeave's payment status and the Phase II funding (already raised as $3.5B of 9.875% notes in July).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print with tenant credit in question. GLXY rose 2.5% on 2026-10-19 on StoneX's reassurance note alone (https://theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-19-galaxy-digital-glxy-stonex-buy-coreweave-helios-ai-data-center-421045).
findings.why_not_priced: The fear is clearly priced: the stock is 5% above its 52w low with a sector-wide AI-debt selloff. What is not priced is management's answer, since there has been no Galaxy statement since 2026-08-05. If the market expected reassurance, the stock would not sit at its lows with short interest rising. Sized small and positive because management will almost certainly reassure, while CoreWeave's own credit is outside Galaxy's control.
findings.independence: The Block / StoneX, 2026-10-19, ties GLXY's two-week ~30% fall to CoreWeave debt concerns (https://theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-19-galaxy-digital-glxy-stonex-buy-coreweave-helios-ai-data-center-421045). Bitcoin miners with AI exposure fell ~12% on 2026-10-14 on the same driver (https://www.altcoinbuzz.io/bitcoin-miners-drop-12-as-ai-data-center-debt-reprices).

findings.finding: Centralized-exchange spot crypto volume fell 14% QoQ in Q3 2026, to $2.49T from $2.88T, the fourth straight quarterly decline. This is a headwind for Galaxy's Global Markets trading line, which earned $49M of adjusted gross profit in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A Barron's headline on an earlier print reads 'Galaxy Digital Stock Is Falling After Earnings Miss. Crypto Trading Declined.' (https://www.itiger.com/hans/news/2557397791, year not confirmed). Q2 2026 Global Markets was +34% QoQ for Digital Assets.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a retail/CEX proxy, and Galaxy is an institutional OTC and derivatives desk where volatility and lending matter more. It is a proxy contradicted in part by the CME series (next finding), so it is filed small.
findings.independence: Robinhood's crypto notional was ~$17B for Sept 1-24 against $17.5B in all of August, down 38% YoY in August (https://investors.robinhood.com/news-releases/news-release-details/robinhood-markets-inc-reports-august-2026-operating-data). This is retail, not Galaxy's client base.

findings.finding: CME reported record crypto futures and options average daily volume for both September and Q3 2026 (release of 2026-10-02). That is the institutional derivatives flow closest to Galaxy's Global Markets client base, and it cuts against the CEX spot decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025, the last strong-institutional-flow quarter (record profit), traded +8.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an industry proxy with no Galaxy confirmation and no figure in the snippet. Sell-side estimates for Global Markets are not public. Filed small as a proxy.
findings.independence: The overall CME record Q3 ADV of 29.4M contracts comes from a separate aggregator (https://www.autobound.ai/companies/cme/news/cme-group-reports-record-average-daily-volume-for-september-05cd8085). Same CME release, so not independent.

findings.finding: Positioning: short interest rose for four straight settlements to 32.63M shares at 2026-09-30, with 6.73 days to cover, and the model estimate for 10-15 is ~33.7M. The stock is 33% down over 20 days and 5.4% above its 52w low, so any reassuring print meets a crowded, building short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Five of the last seven prints were negative, so shorts have been paid into prints. The +5.23% on Q1 2026, despite a $216M loss, shows the stock can rally on a bad headline when positioned short.
findings.why_not_priced: Skew is flat (-1.02), so options do not price a directional squeeze. The short build happened before the October drop; data after 09-30 is not yet published.

findings.finding: The Chief Accounting Officer, Robert Rico, left effective 2026-09-30, the last day of Q3. Q3 is the first close under the new PAO, Dritan Muneka, the internal Head of Accounting Policy and ex-KPMG.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a quiet 8-K that nobody aggregates. The successor is an internal accounting-policy head, so the risk is small, and a restatement or delay signal would have shown in the event timing, which was confirmed on schedule.

findings.finding: Q4-to-date crypto marks are negative. BTC slid to ~$80k by 2026-10-15 (36% off its ATH) from ~$84k at Q3 end, on a hot 3.7% CPI and rate-hike fears. Any QTD treasury or Global Markets commentary on the call will be softer than the Q3 numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Galaxy gives no formal guidance, and QTD tone has not been isolated in the reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, since BTC is a live public price. The October drawdown is modest (~5%) against Q3's +43%. Filed small.

findings.finding: Helios II's ~830 MW of approved capacity is unleased. On the Q2 call management said tenant talks were early, energization is late 2028 and it is being patient, while watching credit-wrap structures. So a new-tenant announcement at this print, which would diversify away from CoreWeave, is a low-probability upside tail.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Helios tenant chatter alone moved the stock +22% once (https://blockspace.media/short/galaxy-digital-shares-jump-22-on-helios-data-center-chatter-and-morgan-stanley-ai-comments-video/, date unverified).
findings.why_not_priced: The market prices no second tenant: GLXY trades as a CoreWeave credit proxy. There is no evidence a deal is imminent, so this is sized as expected value, small.
findings.independence: McGregor campus (July 2026) has no named tenant either (https://theblock.co/post/409911/galaxy-digital-buys-500-acres-in-mcgregor-for-second-texas-ai-data-center-campus).

outside_window.finding: FOMC decision on 2026-10-28, with rate-hike odds raised by the hot CPI. It drives crypto and AI-debt names, but lands the day after the exit window.
Helios Phase II data hall deliveries are expected to begin in Q2 2027.

searched_and_found_nothing: Galaxy 8-Ks since 2026-08-05: only the Item 5.02 CAO change. No financing, buyback, impairment or tenant 8-K in August to October (EDGAR browse, read 2026-10-26)
A named tenant for Helios II or McGregor in October 2026: nothing found
An updated Q3 2026 sell-side preview or October consensus revision: none found beyond the stale aggregator figures
Galaxy Research Q3 2026 crypto lending report: not yet published; the latest is Q2 2026 ($22.98B CeFi borrows, -9.6% QoQ)
Insider Form 4 / Form 144 detail for the 2026-08-21 and 2026-09-09 filings: not resolved to names or sizes through search

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly long against a balanced skew (-1.02) and a -33% run-up. That agrees with the run-up being a CoreWeave-credit sell-off rather than a Q3-results judgement, but cuts against this name's habit of falling after 5 of its last 7 prints, which is why p_up is held at 55.
lessons_applied: Lessons 2 and 6: the treasury mark-to-market finding sits below operating income and the EPS bar is disputed across three sources, so it was cut from +1.5 to +1.0.
Lesson 6: Helios Phase I revenue lands inside the company's own ~$80M guide, so it moved toward 0, from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 5: the CoreWeave-reassurance finding is an inference about what management will say, not a document, so it was cut from +0.8 to +0.6.
Lesson 1: the name has fallen after 5 of its last 7 prints, so p_up moved from 57 to 55. abs_move_pct is unchanged at 11 and expected_move_pct goes from +1.54 to +1.1.
Lesson 7: the crowded and building short (6.73 days to cover) was kept as a positive positioning finding. No negative finding was large enough to need shrinking for squeeze risk.
Left standing: the CEX/CME proxy pair (small, offsetting), the CAO change, the Q4-to-date BTC drift and the Helios II tenant tail.
